sentences.en: And put it on the table.
Juha said: there is a mouse in the house.
And in the evening, he put out bread.
And put out a plate of yoghurt for the cat.
And said: tonight, the mouse dies.
And the cat asleep, with a big belly.
And now I have a mouse and a cat.
